name: SEED_IDLE
meaning: no anim change; not in the world at load, in a container (msg 9) or rolled back (0x55)

name: SEED_STORED
meaning: anim 0 loop; msg 7 (put into the inventory)

name: SEED_HELD
meaning: anim 1 loop; msg 4 (attached to the Wolf/Robot)

name: SEED_PLANTING
meaning: anim 2 blend; msg 5 with drop flag bit 0 (Wolf state 0x29 put-down); Update goes to 4 at anim end

name: SEED_PLANTED
meaning: anim 3 loop|blend; also the state of any seed in the world at level load. Makes Tree msg 0x3280 succeed and msg 0x3300 arg 1
